sd_library.name: KONTAKTS SD Application Library
sd_library.description: Widgets, system wiki/help and offline UPDATE content. Download the ZIP and extract it into the root of the FAT32 SD card; do not flash it to ESP32. The current snapshot includes USB Serial Terminal and its HTML Help pages.

firmwares.name: KONTAKTS Platform / USB Serial Terminal
firmwares.status: PHYSICAL PASS / WEB FLASHER PHYSICAL PASS
firmwares.description: Current KONTAKTS platform with SYS | SD | WIDGET, SD Help Center, Widget Runtime and the generic UART0 serial service used by USB Serial Terminal. On Sample A the normal USB -> CH340C -> UART0 path was physically exercised in both directions, and the 0.3.5 browser Web Flasher install was physically accepted on 2026-09-22.

firmwares.name: KONTAKTS Platform / SD Application Library
firmwares.description: Earlier platform with SYS | SD | WIDGET, hierarchical SD application launcher, Widget Runtime, GitHub OTA/recovery and browser-only SD Help Center.

firmwares.name: KONTAKTS Platform Stable
firmwares.status: PHYSICAL PASS / RECOVERY BASELINE / WEB FLASHER CANDIDATE
firmwares.description: Known-good KONTAKTS platform baseline with firmware-resident STATUS and OTA, persistent filesystem Widget Runtime, NTP clock support, Storage Manager and physically verified live OTA percentage/progress bar. Use this to restore the platform after experimental builds.
